items.story: FDA approves Bayer's asundexian (Sunharbo), first factor XIa blocker, to prevent a repeat stroke, 2026-11-09
items.note: FDA page confirms OCEANIC-STROKE, 12,327 adults, 26% lower ischemic stroke risk, 50 mg with antiplatelet treatment. Major bleeding was similar overall but higher in people over 75 and in the first 90 days, so the first and second claims each give half of the bleeding picture; both halves are correct.

items.story: Nature Biomedical Engineering paper on RetiME, a mortality-risk measure read from retinal photographs (Xu et al.), 2026-11-02
items.note: Title is 'Re-timing mortality risk through individualized modelling of lifespan trajectories'. Abstract confirms training on a European group and checking in three outside groups; the abstract says Southeast Asia, Eurasia and North America, where the claim says Asia. Date confirmed in Crossref too. The publisher's page asked for a sign-in, so the abstract was read at Europe PMC.

items.story: BMJ article 'Surrogate outcomes in clinical research' (Olivier), 2026-11-05
items.note: Crossref confirms title, journal and date. A methods or commentary piece, not a result; only loosely related to ageing.

items.story: FDA investigates tumours after Novartis gene therapy Zolgensma; nine reported cases since 2019, 2026-11-06
items.note: The Endpoints address given refused (403), so the claim was checked against BioSpace, which confirms the investigation and the nine cases. The FDA statement came on Friday 2026-11-06 (worked out from BioSpace's wording 'on Friday' in a story first run on Thursday 2026-11-05), not 2026-11-07 as the claim's date has it; the Endpoints article's own date was not seen. A safety action on a gene therapy for a childhood disease, so only loosely about ageing.

items.story: BioSpace preview of FDA decisions due in November 2026 (ivonescimab, deramiocel, povetacicept), 2026-11-06
items.note: A calendar preview, not a decision. Dates given: ivonescimab Nov 14, Capricor's deramiocel Nov 22, Vertex's povetacicept (for IgA nephropathy) by Nov 30. None is an ageing treatment.

items.story: Muna Therapeutics phase 1 results for MNA-001, an oral TREM2 activator; spinal-fluid ageing markers shifted in elderly volunteers, 2026-11-03
items.note: All details match: exploratory spinal-fluid analysis, no serious adverse events, no participant numbers given, no cognitive benefit shown, phase 2 expected early 2027. Graded A as a first result in people, but it is an exploratory marker finding from a company release with no numbers, so a cautious reader could call it B.

items.story: Full Lp(a)HORIZON results: pelacarsen lowered lipoprotein(a) but not heart events; AHA meeting and NEJM, 2026-11-07
items.note: Second claim matches the source exactly (8,350 people, 77.7% lowering, 12.3% vs 12.1%, hazard ratio 1.02, 0.90 to 1.15, median 4.7 years, Novartis ended the heart programme). First claim's 8,323 patients is close to the 8,322 in the efficacy analysis reported by Healio (8,350 were randomised), so it is off by one or uses a different count. Its death figures (5.7% vs 5.9%) appear in neither article I read, so they are unconfirmed. Topline in September 2026 is confirmed.

items.story: JCI paper: senescent cells drive facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy; lamivudine reduced them in mice (Jung et al.), 2026-11-05
items.note: Crossref record with abstract confirms patient tissue plus mouse model, lamivudine reduced senescence, inflammation and scarring in mice, and the authors call for clinical investigation.

items.story: BioAge Labs third-quarter 2026 results release, 2026-11-05
items.note: The release is real and dated 2026-11-05, but the detail in the claim is wrong. The filed copy says results of the diabetic eye swelling trial (QUELL-DME) are expected in the second half of 2027. What is expected in the last quarter of 2026 is the other trial, QUELL-CV (heart risk and obesity). GlobeNewswire refused (403); read on sec.gov.

items.story: Lilly registers phase 2 trial of bimagrumab in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (NCT07920887, ACTIVATE-HFpEF), first posted 2026-11-06
items.note: Registry confirms 540 estimated, phase 2, placebo control, primary completion July 2029. A first registration of a mid-stage trial; would be A only if bimagrumab is one of the site's tracked treatments.

items.story: STREAM trial: stopping statins in people 70 and over without cardiovascular disease was no worse at two years; AHA meeting and NEJM, 2026-11-08
items.note: Confirmed: nearly 1,900 people, mean age 77.5, open-label non-inferiority. With follow-up to four years, heart attack (1.6% vs 0.6%), ischaemic stroke (2.2% vs 0.8%) and death (9.8% vs 8%) were higher in those who stopped.

items.story: ATTAIN-OSA: orforglipron (Foundayo, Lilly) reduced sleep apnoea severity in two phase 3 trials; AHA meeting, 2026-11-09
items.note: Confirmed: two 52-week phase 3 trials (363 and 349 people), weight, blood pressure and hsCRP improved; also published in JAMA. This Healio article does not mention the plan to seek approval; BioSpace confirms it (see S1176).

items.story: Registry entry NCT07906041: Atria institute's 22-person trial of tirzepatide with a blood-protein brain age as main measure; first posted 2026-10-30, updated 2026-11-02
items.note: Registry confirms sponsor, Vero Bioscience as collaborator, phase 2, 22 estimated, randomised, no masking, enrolling by invitation, main measure the change in proteomic brain age gap at month 6, drug marked as FDA-regulated. The date given is the update of 2026-11-02, the change the claims name; the trial was FIRST posted on 2026-10-30, which is outside the window, and I did not see what the update changed. So the new-trial news itself predates the window by three days. One detail is wrong in the fourth claim: it says 'one group', but the entry has two groups (tirzepatide and usual care with no drug). 'No placebo' is right. The remarks in two claims about a 'first-human test' and 'this entry's test' are the readers' own judgements, not checkable at the source.

items.story: Transplantation Direct paper: human stem cell-derived liver and islet cells placed in the spleen of immunodeficient pigs (Enosawa et al.), 2026-11-06
items.note: Crossref confirms title and date. The title says an 'operational immunodeficient pig model', which may mean pigs made immunodeficient by a procedure, not bred that way; the claim's 'bred without an immune system' is not confirmed. Animal work in a specialist journal, loosely related to ageing.

items.story: Cell Reports mouse study: clearing light-chain amyloid around liver vessels with anselamimab restored aged liver regrowth (Zhang et al.), 2026-11-04
items.note: Abstract at Europe PMC confirms every part of the claim; electronic publication 2026-11-04 (Crossref shows the record created that day, in the November 2026 issue).

items.story: Enlivex 12-month headline results for Allocetra injections in age-related knee osteoarthritis, phase 1/2a, 2026-11-02
items.note: Filed release confirmed. In patients aged 64 and over, 79.2% responded on Allocetra against 47.6% on placebo (p=0.027); the pain and function differences alone did not reach significance (p=0.113 and p=0.067). The company calls itself 'a quality longevity company'. An early-stage, company-reported result in an age subgroup, so a cautious reader could call it B.

items.story: Editas third-quarter 2026 release: Australian clearance to start first trial in people of EDIT-401, an in-body gene editor to lower LDL cholesterol, 2026-11-09
items.note: Filed copy confirms it. Precisely: approval came from a human research ethics committee, and the company completed the notification to Australia's medicines regulator (a notification, not a regulator's approval). The trial, called Strive, is phase 1/2 in adults with inherited high cholesterol; dosing expected to start in 2026, first safety data in the first quarter of 2027. GlobeNewswire refused (403).

items.story: European Heart Journal Open: randomised trial of a multi-ingredient ageing supplement (NOVOS) improved artery measures in 61 healthy adults (Piercy et al.), 2026-11-04
items.note: Abstract confirms 61 randomised (33 and 28), 43 completed, artery widening +2.9 points, pulse wave speed -1.18 m/s, systolic pressure -6.1 mmHg, registry number NCT06145087. NOVOS Labs is listed as funder and one author works there, but the abstract does not name the product 'NOVOS Core'. Not checked by me: the University of Surrey, the control group being five to seven years older, and the lifespan.io coverage of 2026-11-06. Graded A as a trial result in people for a product sold against ageing; it is small, lost about 30% of participants and was maker-funded, so it moves expectations little.

items.story: Humacyte release on its first study in people of an engineered blood vessel for heart bypass surgery, tied to the AHA meeting, 2026-11-09
items.note: GlobeNewswire refused (403); the same release was read on BioSpace. Confirmed: application accepted by the FDA in July 2026, ten adults, phase 2a, the study is now open for enrolment. No results. A separate Humacyte release of 2026-11-03 announced the presentations in advance. The first claim's remark that an engineered vessel 'does not bear on the rung' is the reader's judgement, not checkable.

items.story: FDA final guidance on potency assurance for cell and gene therapies, replacing 2011 guidance, 2026-11-02
items.note: Confirmed: final guidance 'Potency Assurance for Cellular and Gene Therapy Products', replaces the 2011 guidance, covers viral-vector gene therapies, short shelf-life products and patient-specific therapies. A rule for manufacturers, not a decision on a treatment.

items.story: Full Lp(a)HORIZON results: pelacarsen lowered lipoprotein(a) but not heart events; AHA meeting and NEJM, 2026-11-07
items.note: All numbers match Healio: 8,350 randomised, 77.7% lowering, 12.3% vs 12.1%, hazard ratio 1.02.

items.story: Veru release announcing a 2026-11-16 ObesityWeek talk on enobosarm and physical function in older patients on a GLP-1 drug, 2026-11-09
items.note: GlobeNewswire refused; same release read on BioSpace. It only announces the talk (a look-back analysis of people 65 and over in the phase 2b QUALITY study) and gives no new numbers. The results themselves fall after the window.

items.story: ATTAIN-OSA: orforglipron (Foundayo, Lilly) reduced sleep apnoea severity in phase 3; Lilly to file for approval, 2026-11-09
items.note: Confirmed: about 712 adults, 52 weeks, up to 44% fewer breathing interruptions, FDA submission planned before the end of 2026. Healio shows this is two trials (363 and 349 people), which the claims describe as one.

items.story: Resolution Therapeutics interim six-month results for RTX001 engineered macrophage therapy in end-stage liver disease (EMERALD trial), 2026-11-05
items.note: Confirmed: 2 of the first 9 treated against 8 of 21 in an outside comparison group for death, transplant or worsening; meeting with the FDA planned for December 2026. Company release dated 2026-11-05, the article 2026-11-06. Graded A as a result in people, but nine patients against an outside comparison group is weak evidence, so a cautious reader could call it B.

items.story: SYNCHRONIZE-CVOT: survodutide (Boehringer Ingelheim, Zealand) did not raise major heart events against placebo in 5,530 adults; AHA meeting and The Lancet, 2026-11-09
items.note: Second claim matches. First claim says 'not worse than placebo for heart death'; the source says major cardiovascular events, which is broader than heart death. The article confirms the trial was not built to show a benefit and that analysts expect use mainly in people with liver risk; it does not use the words 'favourable trend' and gives no hazard ratio.

items.story: FDA investigates tumours after Novartis gene therapy Zolgensma; nine reported cases since 2019, 2026-11-06
items.note: Confirmed: nine reports since the 2019 approval (two with evidence the carrier virus entered patient DNA), the same risk stated for the related product Itvisma, benefits said to still outweigh risks, monitoring asked for. The FDA statement date of Friday 2026-11-06 is worked out from the article's wording; the article was first run 2026-11-05 and updated 2026-11-09.
